title: Holiday 2026: Geek, Tech, Anime, Games, Comics & Vinyl

toolchain.reason: Freeze exact ranked facts, URLs, timing and shot identifiers before visual production.
Define focal image bounds, hierarchy, safe areas and validation evidence for every scene.
Carry the route marker and ranked decision state across all adjacent scene seams.
Create deterministic source-ranked maps, bars and decision geometry as self-contained SVG assets.
Capture official source pages at the final video crop and record any source-bound fallback.
Own deterministic browser frames, visual identifiers, audio muxing and MP4 validation.
